items: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 reduced the voting age from 21 years to 18 years.
The Model Code of Conduct (MCC) is not a statutory document and lacks independent legal enforceability, though specific provisions are enforced via IPC and RPA 1951.
Proportional Representation by Means of Single Transferable Vote (PR-STV) is used for Presidential, Vice-Presidential, and Rajya Sabha elections, not Lok Sabha.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The First-Past-The-Post (FPTP) system is used for Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assembly elections, where the candidate with the most votes wins.
Article 324 vests the superintendence, direction, and control of elections in the Election Commission of India.
The Model Code of Conduct (MCC) comes into effect immediately upon the announcement of election dates by the Election Commission.
Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT) allows voters to visually verify that their vote has been correctly printed and recorded.
The Representation of the People Act, 1951 details qualifications, disqualifications, and the actual conduct of elections in India.
